summary: Comprehensive testing of RECURSIVE.BBS v0.2.0 code-builder refactor. All 15 backend pytest cases passed (100%) and all 12 frontend playwright checks passed (100%). Backend correctly generates real runnable code per domain, emits a valid zip with one top-level folder + .recursive-bbs.json manifest, generated Python parses as valid AST and contains expected kanban routes. Frontend renders new hero copy, file-tree (6 items including subfolder), code-pane on file click, working download anchor, feedback-up increments composite_score by 0.25, and fork-build correctly sets parent-chip in PromptConsole.
critical_code_review_comments: blueprints.py is ~1035 lines; consider splitting per-blueprint into its own module (blueprints/kanban.py etc.) for maintainability if more domains are added.
Backend uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown') (Pydantic v2 / Starlette suggests lifespan handlers) — minor, not blocking.

list_builds projects out 'files' but the response_model=List[Build] still requires 'files' field; current workaround sets default [] after fetch — fine, but consider a separate BuildSummary model to make API contract explicit.
detect_domain order matters: 'a todo list with kanban-style' would route to kanban — acceptable but document keyword precedence.
Build.files type uses 'list[BuildFile]' annotation; mongo round-trip stores dicts — Pydantic converts on response, but a typed Mongo serializer would be cleaner.
No rate limiting / size limit on /api/builds — anyone can spam build creation. Consider basic throttling for production.
seed_data_creation: Tests created ~7 builds during the run (kanban, notes, habit, chat, generic, fork). Not cleaned up — they feed the leaderboard/lineage which is fine for this app's design.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_code_builder.py. Test file uses module-level pytest attribute to share kanban build id across tests. Domain detection keywords are in blueprints.py _KEYWORDS list. Zip endpoint streams via StreamingResponse and bundles a .recursive-bbs.json manifest at top-level folder.
